'''Edatha''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref><ref name="CEP">{{CSWECite|III|41|Praget, Chairman Krall}}</ref> located in the [[Vatha sector/Legends|Vatha sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Edatha was presented in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] by the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Krall Praget]],<ref name="SL" /><ref name="NOJ" />, who also chaired the [[Council on Security and Intelligence]] during the [[Black Fleet Crisis]],<ref name="SL" /> and remained on the council, advising the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="NOJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Edatha was first mentioned<ref name="SL" /> in the [[1996]] novel ''[[Shield of Lies]]'', written by [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]].<ref name="Date">{{InsiderCite|31|Lucasfilm's Latest}}</ref> In [[1998]],<ref name="San Diego Comic-Con Exclusives">{{ThisWeek|-BZX-WxjhFE|San Diego Comic-Con Exclusives, Brand New LEGO Art, and More!|sw_url=video/san-diego-comic-con-exclusives-brand-new-lego-art-and-more|date=2020-07-02}}</ref> an entry for Edatha was added to the reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which revealed that it was a planet.<ref name="SWE" /> Later, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the [[Edatha system/Legends|Edatha star system]] and the planet itself in grid square K-16.<ref name="EA" />
